δαβιδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1732); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king. KJV: David.

δαιμονιζομαι.def: middle voice from δαίμων (G1142); to be exercised by a dæmon. KJV: have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).

δαιμονιον.def: neuter of a derivative of δαίμων (G1142); a dæmonic being; by extension a deity. KJV: devil, god.

δαιμονιωδησ.def: from δαιμόνιον (G1140) and δαίμων (G1142); dæmon-like. KJV: devilish.

δαιμων.def: from δαίω (to distribute fortunes); a dæmon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature). KJV: devil.

δακνω.def: a prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart. KJV: bite.

δακρυ.def: of uncertain affinity; a tear. KJV: tear.

δακρυω.def: from δάκρυ (G1144); to shed tears. KJV: weep.

δακτυλιοσ.def: from δάκτυλος (G1147); a finger-ring. KJV: ring.

δακτυλοσ.def: probably from δέκα (G1176); a finger. KJV: finger.

δαλμανουθα.def: probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine. KJV: Dalmanutha.

δαλματια.def: probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe. KJV: Dalmatia.

δαμαζω.def: a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to tame. KJV: tame.

δαμαλισ.def: probably from the base of δαμάζω (G1150); a heifer (as tame). KJV: heifer.

δαμαρισ.def: probably from the base of δαμάζω (G1150); perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman. KJV: Damaris.

δαμασκηνοσ.def: from Δαμασκός (G1154); a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus. KJV: Damascene.

δαμασκοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1834); Damascus, a city of Syria. KJV: Damascus.

δανειζω.def: from δάνειον (G1156); to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow. KJV: borrow, lend.

δανειον.def: from δάνος (a gift); probably akin to the base of δίδωμι (G1325); a loan. KJV: debt.

δανειστησ.def: from δανείζω (G1155); a lender. KJV: creditor.

δανιηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1840); Daniel, an Israelite. KJV: Daniel.

δαπαναω.def: from δαπάνη (G1160); to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste. KJV: be at charges, consume, spend.

δαπανη.def: from δάπτω (to devour); expense (as consuming). KJV: cost.

δε.def: a primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc. KJV: also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English).

δεησισ.def: from δέομαι (G1189); a petition. KJV: prayer, request, supplication.

δει.def: 3rd person singular active present of δέω (G1210); also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding). KJV: behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should.

δειγμα.def: from the base of δεικνύω (G1166); a specimen (as shown). KJV: example.

δειγματιζω.def: from δεῖγμα (G1164); to exhibit. KJV: make a shew.

δεικνυω.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to show (literally or figuratively). KJV: shew.

δειλιαω.def: from δειλία (G1167); to be timid. KJV: be afraid.

δειλοσ.def: from δεός (dread); timid, i.e. (by implication) faithless. KJV: fearful.

δεινα.def: probably from the same as δεινῶς (G1171) (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange); so and so (when the person is not specified). KJV: such a man.

δεινωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of the same as δειλός (G1169); terribly, i.e. excessively. KJV: grievously, vehemently.

δειπνεω.def: from δεῖπνον (G1173); to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal. KJV: sup (X -er).

δειπνον.def: from the same as δαπάνη (G1160); dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening). KJV: feast, supper.

δεισιδαιμονεστεροσ.def: the compound of a derivative of the base of δειλός (G1169) and δαίμων (G1142); more religious than others. KJV: too superstitious.

δεισιδαιμονια.def: from the same as δεισιδαιμονέστερος (G1174); religion. KJV: superstition.

δεκα.def: a primary number; ten. KJV: (eight-)een, ten.

δεκαδυο.def: from δέκα (G1176) and δύο (G1417); two and ten, i.e. twelve. KJV: twelve.

δεκαπεντε.def: from δέκα (G1176) and πέντε (G4002); ten and five, i.e. fifteen. KJV: fifteen.

δεκαπολισ.def: from δέκα (G1176) and πόλις (G4172); the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria. KJV: Decapolis.

δεκατεσσαρεσ.def: from δέκα (G1176) and τέσσαρες (G5064); ten and four, i.e. fourteen. KJV: fourteen.

δεκατη.def: feminine of δέκατος (G1182); a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe. KJV: tenth (part), tithe.

δεκατοσ.def: ordinal from δέκα (G1176); tenth. KJV: tenth.

δεκατοω.def: from δεκάτη (G1181); to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth. KJV: pay (receive) tithes.

δεκτοσ.def: from δέχομαι (G1209); approved; (figuratively) propitious. KJV: accepted(-table).

δελεαζω.def: from the base of δόλος (G1388); to entrap, i.e. (figuratively) delude. KJV: allure, beguile, entice.

δενδρον.def: probably from δρύς (an oak); a tree. KJV: tree.

δεξιολαβοσ.def: from δεξιός (G1188) and λαμβάνω (G2983); a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier. KJV: spearman.

δεξιοσ.def: from δέχομαι (G1209); the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes). KJV: right (hand, side).

δεομαι.def: middle voice of δέω (G1210); to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition. KJV: beseech, pray (to), make request.

δερβαιοσ.def: from Δέρβη (G1191); a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe. KJV: of Derbe.

δερβη.def: of foreign origin; Derbe, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Derbe.

δερμα.def: from δέρω (G1194); a hide. KJV: skin.

δερματινοσ.def: from δέρμα (G1192); made of hide. KJV: leathern, of a skin.

δερω.def: a primary verb; properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash. KJV: beat, smite.

δεσμευω.def: from a (presumed) derivative of δεσμέω (G1196); to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load). KJV: bind.

δεσμεω.def: from δεσμόν (G1199); to tie, i.e. shackle. KJV: bind.

δεσμη.def: from δεσμέω (G1196); a bundle. KJV: bundle.

δεσμιοσ.def: from δεσμόν (G1199); a captive (as bound). KJV: in bonds, prisoner.

δεσμον.def: neuter and masculine respectively from δέω (G1210); a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability. KJV: band, bond, chain, string.

δεσμοφυλαξ.def: from δεσμόν (G1199) and φύλαξ (G5441); a jailer (as guarding the prisoners). KJV: jailor, keeper of the prison.

δεσμωτηριον.def: from a derivative of δεσμόν (G1199) (equivalent to δεσμέω (G1196)); a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon. KJV: prison.

δεσμωτησ.def: from the same as δεσμωτήριον (G1201); (passively) a captive. KJV: prisoner.

δεσποτησ.def: perhaps from δέω (G1210) and πόσις (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"). KJV: Lord, master.

δευρο.def: of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto. KJV: come (hither), hither(-to).

δευτε.def: from δεῦρο (G1204) and an imperative form of εἶμι (to go); come hither!. KJV: come, X follow.

δευτεραιοσ.def: from δεύτερος (G1208); secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day. KJV: next day.

δευτεροπρωτοσ.def: from δεύτερος (G1208) and πρῶτος (G4413); second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost). KJV: second … after the first.

δευτεροσ.def: as the comparative of δύο (G1417); (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb). KJV: afterward, again, second(-arily, time).

δεχομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively). KJV: accept, receive, take.

δεω.def: a primary verb; to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively). KJV: bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind.

δη.def: probably akin to δέ (G1161); a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc. KJV: also, and, doubtless, now, therefore.

δηλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; clear. KJV: + bewray, certain, evident, manifest.

δηλοω.def: from δῆλος (G1212); to make plain (by words). KJV: declare, shew, signify.

δημασ.def: probably for Δημήτριος (G1216); Demas, a Christian. KJV: Demas.

δημηγορεω.def: from a compound of δῆμος (G1218) and ἀγορά (G58); to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly. KJV: make an oration.

δημητριοσ.def: from Δημήτηρ (Ceres); Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian. KJV: Demetrius.

δημιουργοσ.def: from δῆμος (G1218) and ἔργον (G2041); a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator). KJV: maker.

δημοσ.def: from δέω (G1210); the public (as bound together socially). KJV: people.

δημοσιοσ.def: from δῆμος (G1218); public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public. KJV: common, openly, publickly.

δηναριον.def: of Latin origin; a denarius (or ten asses). KJV: pence, penny(-worth).

δηποτε.def: from δή (G1211) and ποτέ (G4218); a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time. KJV: (what-)soever.

δηπου.def: from δή (G1211) and πού (G4225); a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless. KJV: verily.

δια.def: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional). KJV: after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in).

διαβαινω.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of βάσις (G939); to cross. KJV: come over, pass (through).

διαβαλλω.def: from διά (G1223) and βάλλω (G906); (figuratively) to traduce. KJV: accuse.

διαβεβαιοομαι.def: middle voice of a compound of διά (G1223) and βεβαιόω (G950); to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate. KJV: affirm constantly.

διαβλεπω.def: from διά (G1223) and βλέπω (G991); to look through, i.e. recover full vision. KJV: see clearly.

διαβολοσ.def: from διαβάλλω (G1225); a traducer; specially, Satan (compare H7854). KJV: false accuser, devil, slanderer.

διαγγελλω.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to herald thoroughly. KJV: declare, preach, signify.

διαγινομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and γίνομαι (G1096); to elapse meanwhile. KJV: X after, be past, be spent.

διαγινωσκω.def: from διά (G1223) and γινώσκω (G1097); to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly. KJV: (would) enquire, know the uttermost.

διαγνωριζω.def: from γραπτός (G1123) and γνωρίζω (G1107); to tell abroad. KJV: make known.

διαγογγυζω.def: from διά (G1223) and γογγύζω (G1111); to complain throughout a crowd. KJV: murmur.

διαγρηγορεω.def: from διά (G1223) and γρηγορεύω (G1127); to waken thoroughly. KJV: be awake.

διαγω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἄγω (G71); to pass time or life. KJV: lead life, living.

διαδεχομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and δέχομαι (G1209); to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to. KJV: come after.

διαδημα.def: from a compound of διά (G1223) and δέω (G1210); a "diadem" (as bound about the head). KJV: crown.

διαδιδωμι.def: from διά (G1223) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor). KJV: (make) distribute(-ion), divide, give.

διαδοχοσ.def: from διαδέχομαι (G1237); a successor in office. KJV: room.

διαζωννυμι.def: from διά (G1223) and ζώννυμι (G2224); to gird tightly. KJV: gird.

διαθηκη.def: from διατίθεμαι (G1303); properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will). KJV: covenant, testament.

διαιρεσισ.def: from διαιρέω (G1244); a distinction or (concretely) variety. KJV: difference, diversity.

διαιρεω.def: from διά (G1223) and αἱρέομαι (G138); to separate, i.e. distribute. KJV: divide.

διακαθαριζω.def: from διά (G1223) and καθαρίζω (G2511); to cleanse perfectly, i.e. (specially) winnow. KJV: thoroughly purge.

διακατελεγχομαι.def: middle voice from διά (G1223) and a compound of κατά (G2596) and ἐλέγχω (G1651); to prove downright, i.e. confute. KJV: convince.

διακονεω.def: from διάκονος (G1249); to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon. KJV: (ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon.

διακονια.def: from διάκονος (G1249); attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate). KJV: (ad-)minister(-ing, -tration, -try), office, relief, service(-ing).

διακονοσ.def: probably from an obsolete διάκω (to run on errands; compare διώκω (G1377)); an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess). KJV: deacon, minister, servant.

διακοσιοι.def: from δίς (G1364) and ἑκατόν (G1540); two hundred. KJV: two hundred.

διακουομαι.def: middle voice from διά (G1223) and ἀκούω (G191); to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea). KJV: hear.

διακρινω.def: from διά (G1223) and κρίνω (G2919); to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate. KJV: contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver.

διακρισισ.def: from διακρίνω (G1252); judicial estimation. KJV: discern(-ing), disputation.

διακωλυω.def: from διά (G1223) and κωλύω (G2967); to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit. KJV: forbid.

διαλαλεω.def: from διά (G1223) and λαλέω (G2980); to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish. KJV: commune, noise abroad.

διαλεγομαι.def: middle voice from διά (G1223) and λέγω (G3004); to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation). KJV: dispute, preach (unto), reason (with), speak.

διαλειπω.def: from διά (G1223) and λείπω (G3007); to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit. KJV: cease.

διαλεκτοσ.def: from διαλέγομαι (G1256); a (mode of) discourse, i.e. "dialect". KJV: language, tongue.

διαλλασσω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate. KJV: reconcile.

διαλογιζομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and λογίζομαι (G3049); to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion). KJV: cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think.

διαλογισμοσ.def: from διαλογίζομαι (G1260); discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate. KJV: dispute, doubtful(-ing), imagination, reasoning, thought.

διαλυω.def: from διά (G1223) and λύω (G3089); to dissolve utterly. KJV: scatter.

διαμαρτυρομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and μαρτυρέω (G3140); to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively. KJV: charge, testify (unto), witness.

διαμαχομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and μάχομαι (G3164); to fight fiercely (in altercation). KJV: strive.

διαμενω.def: from διά (G1223) and μένω (G3306); to stay constantly (in being or relation). KJV: continue, remain.

διαμεριζω.def: from διά (G1223) and μερίζω (G3307); to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension). KJV: cloven, divide, part.

διαμερισμοσ.def: from διαμερίζω (G1266); disunion (of opinion and conduct). KJV: division.

διανεμω.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of νόμος (G3551); to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate. KJV: spread.

διανευω.def: from διά (G1223) and νεύω (G3506); to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space. KJV: beckon.

διανοημα.def: from a compound of διά (G1223) and νοιέω (G3539); something thought through, i.e. a sentiment. KJV: thought.

διανοια.def: from διά (G1223) and νοῦς (G3563); deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise. KJV: imagination, mind, understanding.

διανοιγω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἀνοίγω (G455); to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound). KJV: open.

διανυκτερευω.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of νύξ (G3571); to sit up the whole night. KJV: continue all night.

διανυω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἀνύω (to effect); to accomplish thoroughly. KJV: finish.

διαπαντοσ.def: from διά (G1223) and the genitive case of πᾶς (G3956); through all time, i.e. (adverbially) constantly. KJV: alway(-s), continually.

διαπεραω.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of the base of πέραν (G4008); to cross entirely. KJV: go over, pass (over), sail over.

διαπλεω.def: from διά (G1223) and πλέω (G4126); to sail through. KJV: sail over.

διαπονεω.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of πόνος (G4192); to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried. KJV: be grieved.

διαπορευομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to travel through. KJV: go through, journey in, pass by.

διαπορεω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἀπορέω (G639); to be thoroughly nonplussed. KJV: (be in) doubt, be (much) perplexed.

διαπραγματευομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and πραγματεύομαι (G4231); to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business. KJV: gain by trading.

διαπριω.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of πρίζω (G4249); to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate. KJV: cut (to the heart).

διαρπαζω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἁρπάζω (G726); to seize asunder, i.e. plunder. KJV: spoil.

διαρρησσω.def: from διά (G1223) and ῥήγνυμι (G4486); to tear asunder. KJV: break, rend.

διασαφεω.def: from διά (G1223) and σαφής (clear); to clear thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) declare. KJV: tell unto.

διασειω.def: from διά (G1223) and σείω (G4579); to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate. KJV: do violence to.

διασκορπιζω.def: from διά (G1223) and σκορπίζω (G4650); to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander. KJV: disperse, scatter (abroad), strew, waste.

διασπαω.def: from διά (G1223) and σπάω (G4685); to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember. KJV: pluck asunder, pull in pieces.

διασπειρω.def: from διά (G1223) and σπείρω (G4687); to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands. KJV: scatter abroad.

διασπορα.def: from διασπείρω (G1289); dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries. KJV: (which are) scattered (abroad).

διαστελλομαι.def: middle voice from διά (G1223) and στέλλω (G4724); to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin. KJV: charge, that which was (give) commanded(-ment).

διαστημα.def: from διΐστημι (G1339); an interval. KJV: space.

διαστολη.def: from διαστέλλομαι (G1291); a variation. KJV: difference, distinction.

διαστρεφω.def: from διά (G1223) and στρέφω (G4762); to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt. KJV: perverse(-rt), turn away.

διασωζω.def: from διά (G1223) and σώζω (G4982); to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc. KJV: bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save.

διαταγη.def: from διατάσσω (G1299); arrangement, i.e. institution. KJV: instrumentality.

διαταγμα.def: from διατάσσω (G1299); an arrangement, i.e. (authoritative) edict. KJV: commandment.

διαταρασσω.def: from διά (G1223) and ταράσσω (G5015); to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm). KJV: trouble.

διατασσω.def: from διά (G1223) and τάσσω (G5021); to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc. KJV: appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain.

διατελεω.def: from διά (G1223) and τελέω (G5055); to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist. KJV: continue.

διατηρεω.def: from διά (G1223) and τηρέω (G5083); to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly. KJV: keep.

διατι.def: from διά (G1223) and τίς (G5101); through what cause ?, i.e. why?. KJV: wherefore, why.

διατιθεμαι.def: middle voice from διά (G1223) and τίθημι (G5087); to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest). KJV: appoint, make, testator.

διατριβω.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of τρίβος (G5147); to wear through (time), i.e. remain. KJV: abide, be, continue, tarry.

διατροφη.def: from a compound of διά (G1223) and τρέφω (G5142); nourishment. KJV: food.

διαυγαζω.def: from διά (G1223) and αὐγάζω (G826); to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day). KJV: dawn.

διαφανησ.def: from διά (G1223) and φαίνω (G5316); appearing through, i.e. "diaphanous". KJV: transparent.

διαφερω.def: from διά (G1223) and φέρω (G5342); to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass. KJV: be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value.

διαφευγω.def: from διά (G1223) and φεύγω (G5343); to flee through, i.e. escape. KJV: escape.

διαφημιζω.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of φήμη (G5345); to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate. KJV: blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.

διαφθειρω.def: from διαβάλλω (G1225) and φθείρω (G5351); to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert). KJV: corrupt, destroy, perish.

διαφοροσ.def: from διαφέρω (G1308); varying; also surpassing. KJV: differing, divers, more excellent.

διαφυλασσω.def: from διά (G1223) and φυλάσσω (G5442); to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect. KJV: keep.

διαχειριζομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of χείρ (G5495); to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon. KJV: kill, slay.

διαχωριζομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and the middle voice of χωρίζω (G5563); to remove (oneself) wholly, i.e. retire. KJV: depart.

διδακτικοσ.def: from διδακτός (G1318); instructive ("didactic"). KJV: apt to teach.

διδακτοσ.def: from διδάσκω (G1321); (subjectively) instructed, or (objectively) communicated by teaching. KJV: taught, which … teacheth.

διδασκαλια.def: from διδάσκαλος (G1320); instruction (the function or the information). KJV: doctrine, learning, teaching.

διδασκαλοσ.def: from διδάσκω (G1321); an instructor (genitive case or specially). KJV: doctor, master, teacher.

διδασκω.def: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb δάω (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application). KJV: teach.

διδαχη.def: from διδάσκω (G1321); instruction (the act or the matter). KJV: doctrine, hath been taught.

διδραχμον.def: from δίς (G1364) and δραχμή (G1406); a double drachma (didrachm). KJV: tribute.

διδυμοσ.def: prolongation from δίς (G1364); double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian. KJV: Didymus.

διδωμι.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection). KJV: adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.

διεγειρω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἐγείρω (G1453); to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively). KJV: arise, awake, raise, stir up.

διεξοδοσ.def: from διά (G1223) and ἔξοδος (G1841); an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge). KJV: highway.

διερμηνευτησ.def: from διερμηνεύω (G1329); an explainer. KJV: interpreter.

διερμηνευω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἑρμηνεύω (G2059); to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate. KJV: expound, interpret(-ation).

διερχομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to traverse (literally). KJV: come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through.

διερωταω.def: from διά (G1223) and ἐρωτάω (G2065); to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation. KJV: make enquiry for.

διετησ.def: from δίς (G1364) and ἔτος (G2094); of two years (in age). KJV: two years old.

διετια.def: from διετής (G1332); a space of two years (biennium). KJV: two years.

διηγεομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); to relate fully. KJV: declare, shew, tell.

διηγεσισ.def: from διηγέομαι (G1334); a recital. KJV: declaration.

διηνεκησ.def: neuter of a compound of διά (G1223) and a derivative of an alternate of φέρω (G5342); carried through, i.e. (adverbially with εἰς (G1519) and ὁ (G3588) prefixed) perpetually. KJV: + continually, for ever.

διθαλασσοσ.def: from δίς (G1364) and θάλασσα (G2281); having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet. KJV: where two seas meet.

διικνεομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and the base of ἱκανός (G2425); to reach through, i.e. penetrate. KJV: pierce.

διιστημι.def: from διά (G1223) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene. KJV: go further, be parted, after the space of.

διισχυριζομαι.def: from διά (G1223) and a derivative of ἰσχυρός (G2478); to stout it through, i.e. asservate. KJV: confidently (constantly) affirm.

δικαιοκρισια.def: from δίκαιος (G1342) and κρίσις (G2920); a just sentence. KJV: righteous judgment.

δικαιοσ.def: from δίκη (G1349); equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively). KJV: just, meet, right(-eous).

δικαιοσυνη.def: from δίκαιος (G1342); equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification. KJV: righteousness.

δικαιοω.def: from δίκαιος (G1342); to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent. KJV: free, justify(-ier), be righteous.

δικαιωμα.def: from δικαιόω (G1344); an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision. KJV: judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.

δικαιωσ.def: adverb from δίκαιος (G1342); equitably. KJV: justly, (to) righteously(-ness).

δικαιωσισ.def: from δικαιόω (G1344); aquittal (for Christ's sake). KJV: justification.

δικαστησ.def: from a derivative of δίκη (G1349); a judger. KJV: judge.

δικη.def: probably from δεικνύω (G1166); right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution). KJV: judgment, punish, vengeance.

δικτυον.def: probably from a primary verb δίκω (to cast); a seine (for fishing). KJV: net.

διλογοσ.def: from δίς (G1364) and λόγος (G3056); equivocal, i.e. telling a different story. KJV: double-tongued.

διο.def: from διά (G1223) and ὅς (G3739); through which thing, i.e. consequently. KJV: for which cause, therefore, wherefore.

διοδευω.def: from διά (G1223) and ὁδεύω (G3593); to travel through. KJV: go throughout, pass through.

διονυσιοσ.def: from Διόνυσος (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian. KJV: Dionysius.

διοπερ.def: from διό (G1352) and περ (G4007); on which very account. KJV: wherefore.

διοπετησ.def: from the alternate of Ζεύς (G2203) and the alternate of πίπτω (G4098); sky-fallen (i.e. an aerolite). KJV: which fell down from Jupiter.

διορθωσισ.def: from a compound of διά (G1223) and a derivative of ὀρθός (G3717), meaning to straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic restauration. KJV: reformation.

διορυσσω.def: from διά (G1223) and ὀρύσσω (G3736); to penetrate burglariously. KJV: break through (up).

διοσκουροι.def: from the alternate of Ζεύς (G2203) and a form of the base of κοράσιον (G2877); sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri. KJV: Castor and Pollux.

διοτι.def: from διά (G1223) and ὅτι (G3754); on the very account that, or inasmuch as. KJV: because (that), for, therefore.

διοτρεφησ.def: from the alternate of Ζεύς (G2203) and τρέφω (G5142); Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity. KJV: Diotrephes.

διπλουσ.def: from δίς (G1364) and (probably) the base of πλείων (G4119); two-fold. KJV: double, two-fold more.

διπλοω.def: from διπλοῦς (G1362); to render two-fold. KJV: double.

δισ.def: adverb from δύο (G1417); twice. KJV: again, twice.

δισταζω.def: from δίς (G1364); properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion). KJV: doubt.

διστομοσ.def: from δίς (G1364) and στόμα (G4750); double-edged. KJV: with two edges, two-edged.

δισχιλιοι.def: from δίς (G1364) and χίλιοι (G5507); two thousand. KJV: two thousand.

διυλιζω.def: from διά (G1223) and ὑλίζω (to filter); to strain out. KJV: strain at (probably by misprint).

διχαζω.def: from a derivative of δίς (G1364); to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate). KJV: set at variance.

διχοστασια.def: from a derivative of δίς (G1364) and στάσις (G4714); disunion, i.e. (figuratively) dissension. KJV: division, sedition.

διχοτομεω.def: from a compound of a derivative of δίς (G1364) and a derivative of τέμνω (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely. KJV: cut asunder (in sunder).

διψαω.def: from a variation of δίψος (G1373); to thirst for (literally or figuratively). KJV: (be, be a-)thirst(-y).

διψοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; thirst. KJV: thirst.

διψυχοσ.def: from δίς (G1364) and ψυχή (G5590); two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose). KJV: double minded.

διωκτησ.def: from διώκω (G1377); a persecutor. KJV: persecutor.

διωκω.def: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb δίω (to flee; compare the base of δειλός (G1169) and διάκονος (G1249)); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute. KJV: ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.

δογμα.def: from the base of δοκέω (G1380); a law (civil, ceremonial or ecclesiastical). KJV: decree, ordinance.

δογματιζω.def: from δόγμα (G1378); to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule. KJV: be subject to ordinances.

δοκεω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, δόκω (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of δεικνύω (G1166)) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly). KJV: be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow.

δοκιμαζω.def: from δόκιμος (G1384); to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve. KJV: allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.

δοκιμη.def: from the same as δόκιμος (G1384); test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness. KJV: experience(-riment), proof, trial.

δοκιμιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of δοκιμή (G1382); a testing; by implication, trustworthiness. KJV: trial, trying.

δοκιμοσ.def: from δοκέω (G1380); properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved. KJV: approved, tried.

δοκοσ.def: from δέχομαι (G1209) (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber. KJV: beam.

δολιοω.def: from δόλιος (G1386); to be guileful. KJV: use deceit.

δολοσ.def: from an obsolete primary verb, δέλλω (probably meaning to decoy; compare δελεάζω (G1185)); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile. KJV: craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.

δολοω.def: from δόλος (G1388); to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate. KJV: handle deceitfully.

δομα.def: from the base of δίδωμι (G1325); a present. KJV: gift.

δοξα.def: from the base of δοκέω (G1380); glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective). KJV: dignity, glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.

δοξαζω.def: from δόξα (G1391); to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application). KJV: (make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.

δορκασ.def: gazelle; Dorcas, a Christian woman. KJV: Dorcas.

δοσισ.def: from the base of δίδωμι (G1325); a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift. KJV: gift, giving.

δοτησ.def: from the base of δίδωμι (G1325); a giver. KJV: giver.

δουλαγωγεω.def: from a presumed compound of δοῦλος (G1401) and ἄγω (G71); to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue). KJV: bring into subjection.

δουλεια.def: from δουλεύω (G1398); slavery (ceremonially or figuratively). KJV: bondage.

δουλευω.def: from δοῦλος (G1401); to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary). KJV: be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).

δουλη.def: feminine of δοῦλος (G1401); a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily). KJV: handmaid(-en).

δουλον.def: neuter of δοῦλος (G1401); subservient. KJV: servant.

δουλοσ.def: from δέω (G1210); a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency). KJV: bond(-man), servant.

δουλοω.def: from δοῦλος (G1401); to enslave (literally or figuratively). KJV: bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.

δοχη.def: from δέχομαι (G1209); a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment. KJV: feast.

δρακων.def: probably from an alternate form of δέρκομαι (to look); a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate). KJV: dragon.

δρασσομαι.def: perhaps akin to the base of δράκων (G1404) (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap. KJV: take.

δραχμη.def: from δράσσομαι (G1405); a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled). KJV: piece (of silver).

δρεπανον.def: from δρέπω (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for harvesting). KJV: sickle.

δρομοσ.def: from the alternate of τρέχω (G5143); a race, i.e. (figuratively) career. KJV: course.

δρουσιλλα.def: a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family. KJV: Drusilla.

δυναμαι.def: of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible. KJV: be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.

δυναμισ.def: from δύναμαι (G1410); force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself). KJV: ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.

δυναμοω.def: from δύναμις (G1411); to enable. KJV: strengthen.

δυναστησ.def: from δύναμαι (G1410); a ruler or officer. KJV: of great authority, mighty, potentate.

δυνατεω.def: from δυνατός (G1415); to be efficient (figuratively). KJV: be mighty.

δυνατοσ.def: from δύναμαι (G1410); powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible. KJV: able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.

δυνω.def: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary δύο (to sink); to go "down". KJV: set.

δυο.def: a primary numeral; "two". KJV: both, twain, two.

δυσ.def: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty. KJV: + hard, + grievous, etc.

δυσβαστακτοσ.def: from δυσ- (G1418) and a derivative of βαστάζω (G941); oppressive. KJV: grievous to be borne.

δυσεντερια.def: from δυσ- (G1418) and a comparative of ἐντός (G1787) (meaning a bowel); a "dysentery". KJV: bloody flux.

δυσερμηνευτοσ.def: from δυσ- (G1418) and a presumed derivative of ἑρμηνεύω (G2059); difficult of explanation. KJV: hard to be uttered.

δυσκολοσ.def: from δυσ- (G1418) and κόλον (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable. KJV: hard.

δυσκολωσ.def: adverb from δύσκολος (G1422); impracticably. KJV: hardly.

δυσμη.def: from δύνω (G1416); the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region. KJV: west.

δυσνοητοσ.def: from δυσ- (G1418) and a derivative of νοιέω (G3539); difficult of perception. KJV: hard to be understood.

δυσφημια.def: from a compound of δυσ- (G1418) and φήμη (G5345); defamation. KJV: evil report.

δωδεκα.def: from δύο (G1417) and δέκα (G1176); two and ten, i.e. a dozen. KJV: twelve.

δωδεκαφυλον.def: from δώδεκα (G1427) and φυλή (G5443); the commonwealth of Israel. KJV: twelve tribes.

δωμα.def: from δέμω (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a roof. KJV: housetop.

δωρεα.def: from δῶρον (G1435); a gratuity. KJV: gift.

δωρεαν.def: accusative case of δωρεά (G1431) as adverb; gratuitously (literally or figuratively). KJV: without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.

δωρεομαι.def: middle voice from δῶρον (G1435); to bestow gratuitously. KJV: give.

δωρημα.def: from δωρέομαι (G1433); a bestowment. KJV: gift.

δωρον.def: a present; specially, a sacrifice. KJV: gift, offering.
